_doc: flow_cmp v2 allow-list: differences the SIM build (SOFT_SIMULTE) is EXPECTED to show against a real-machine StateRecord.
Every entry MUST carry golden_cite (golden 906 file:line); flow_cmp refuses the whole file otherwise. Seeded 20260927 from
the research report staterecord-flow-gap.md section 4 (AL-1..AL-12); cites were re-read in golden 906 on 20260927 and
again on 20260928 (every cite opened; AL-9 narrowed to 450 after reading case 400).
rule.kind: skip-steps {steps, between?:[a,b]} = SIM never records these steps (with between: only a run of them directly
between a and b is removed); replace {pairs:[{from,to}]} = a contiguous run is recorded differently in SIM; stays {value} =
in SIM the task never leaves value (exact match); cycle-only = compare the steady loop only (ring full); exclude-row = row
left out of every section; info = no sequence effect, kept so the report can cite it.
task: one alias or a list of aliases. flow_cmp tries the task's sequence rules in every combination (smallest first) and
names the ones it needed; a raw match is EQUAL, a match that needed rules is EQUAL-mod-AL.
status: verified = the SIM behaviour was read in golden code; unverified = still an inference (see verify_note). Unverified
entries are applied like the others but the report marks them with '?'.
pending: proposals WITHOUT a golden citation. They are never applied; the report only mentions them next to the task.

under #ifdef SOFT_SIMULTE the picked IC becomes NULL_IC (:2685-2686), so case 400 never finds HAS_SUCK_IC: the WAR0170 branch (:2818-2829, the function's only Task=450) is unreachable and case 400 goes on to Task=500 (:2841).
